title: EU AI Act GPAI Code of Practice: September 2026 Compliance Checkpoint
hook: The EU AI Act's general-purpose AI provisions took effect 2 August 2025. The GPAI Code of Practice — developed by industry stakeholders under AI Office oversight — reached its third draft in early 2026. By September 2026, model providers face the practical question: sign the voluntary code or prepare for direct enforcement under Articles 53-55.
answer_first: The GPAI Code of Practice covers transparency, copyright, safety, and security obligations for general-purpose AI model providers. Providers who sign the code benefit from a presumption of conformity with Articles 53-55 of the EU AI Act. Those who decline face the AI Office's direct oversight and potential enforcement. Council's verified measurement credential provides independent evidence of conformity regardless of code signature status.
council_position: Council of AI measures GPAI models against the Code's transparency and safety benchmarks. Our board shows which models meet or fall short of the Code's technical thresholds. A signed Code is a legal shield; a Council measurement is an audit-grade proof point. Both matter.
